protocol: Exploratory official dev fixed-weight ensemble. Every CE is z-normalized on the same 100 candidates, averaged within view and re-standardized. The equal arms weight CE and dense equally. CE=0.7 transfers the prior seed-17 internal choice. No fitting or weights chosen on official dev. Standalone ensembles use three or six CE passes per query in deployment. The inputs reuse cached scores.
transfer_protocol: Transfer the original external-six decision to the 0.7 full-query ensemble when the same incumbent remains in its top ten and the original challenger is outside. Apply the swap at the incumbent’s current rank.
